description: Conversion from two flats into a house with the erection of a single storey rear infill and a rear roof extension with one front roof window, conversion of the garage into a habitable space with insertion of roof and side windows
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.
Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [Design and Access statement, 2505.RID.011, 2505.RID.010, 2505.RID.002, 2505.RID.001, 2505.RID.000, 2505.RID.020, 2505.RID.FS01 Fire Statement, 2505.RID.LP01, 2505.RID.BP01 received 27/04/2026
2505.RID.111 Rev A, 2505.RID.110 Rev B, 2505.RID.101 Rev B, 2505.RID.100 Rev B, 2505.RID.102 Rev A, 2505.RID.120, Planning statement received 09/06/2026
Estate agent letter received 10/06/2026
].
Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Reason: In order to safeguard the appearance of the area.

Condition : 4 - The window(s) to be fitted on the [front/rear] roof face of the dwelling shall be black-framed and traditional, conservation-style.
Reason: In order to safeguard the architectural and historic interest of the [conservation area/listed building].

Condition : 5 - The detached single storey outbuilding hereby permitted shall only be used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the house at the '42 The Ridgeway. Chiswick, London, W3 8LN' described at the top of this decision letter and for no other purpose (for example, it may not be used as a self-contained dwelling or contain a bedroom, bathroom, kitchen or other primary residential accommodation, nor may it be used for business purposes). 
Reason: In order to protect neighbours' living conditions and the character of the area.
